title: Oozy Crisp Thai Chicken Larb
description: A jammy, crisp, and indulgent Thai dish featuring dashi and lamination-puff, this low-sodium-friendly larb is a central-Thai inspired delight. It combines the richness of chicken with the brightness of herbs and chilies.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together dashi powder and 1 tablespoon of water to make a paste.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the dashi paste.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced shallots to the skillet and cook until they start to caramelize, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the chopped cilantro, mint, lime juice, fish sauce, and chili flakes, and cook for 1 minute.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spoon the chicken and shallot mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with a little water and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the larb for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and puffed.
